Specification: This specification models attacker isolation at a full node after it receives evidence from a light client about conflicting blocks. It assumes a Tendermint-like setting with unit voting power per validator, a trusted common height, a conflicting height, and a violated security model in which Byzantine validators may have signed a conflicting block. The spec initializes an arbitrary blockchain and conflicting evidence, then classifies the attack into Lunatic, Equivocation, or Amnesia cases and computes a set of attackers; it checks invariants asserting that the detected attackers have more than one third of the voting power and that all detected attackers are faulty.
IfThenElse: IF ViolatesValidity(reference, evidenceHeader) THEN /\ attackers' := blockchain[COMMON_HEIGHT].NextVS \intersect evidenceCommit /\ state' := "Lunatic" ELSE IF referenceRound = evidenceRound THEN /\ attackers' := referenceCommit \intersect evidenceCommit /\ state' := "Equivocation" ELSE /\ state' := "Amnesia" /\ \E Attackers \in SUBSET (Faulty \intersect reference.VS): /\ 3 * Cardinality(Attackers) > Cardinality(reference.VS) /\ attackers' := Attackers

IF referenceRound = evidenceRound THEN /\ attackers' := referenceCommit \intersect evidenceCommit /\ state' := "Equivocation" ELSE /\ state' := "Amnesia" /\ \E Attackers \in SUBSET (Faulty \intersect reference.VS): /\ 3 * Cardinality(Attackers) > Cardinality(reference.VS) /\ attackers' := Attackers
